file: Dark Nights_ Death Metal Reading Order.html
title: Dark Nights: Death Metal
Flashpoint
chars: The Flash,  Batman,  Booster Gold,  Wonder Woman,  Aquaman
desc: Barry Allen wakes up to discover everything and everyone around him has changed.  The Flash,  the Justice League,  and even Superman do not exist.  Barry realizes that the world of Flashpoint is not a parallel dimension,  but an alternate reality and he must reset the timeline.

title: Green Lantern: Godhead
desc: The New Gods war with the Lantern Corps in search for a power to defeat Darkseid.  Highfather learns that ring-wielders stole secrets from beyond the Source Wall.  Highfather wants to do the same but first he needs his own set of rings.

file: Green Lantern_ Lights Out Reading Order.html
title: Green Lantern: Lights Out
desc: Relic,  a being from another universe,  aims to destroy the emotional spectrum of the Lantern Corps.  The lights of the Lanterns are fading as the emotional spectrum is being drained.

title: Green Lantern: Uprising
desc: The Durlans,  a shape-shifting race of aliens, have infiltrated the ranks of the Green Lantern Corps and,  through manipulation, have turned much of the universe against the Corp.

file: Red Daughter of Krypton Reading Order.html
title: Red Daughter of Krypton
desc: Kara is done with people pushing her around,  taking advantage of her and betraying her.  She’s done feeling helpless,  lost,  and discarded.  She’s done with hope,  faith,  and acceptance.  Now all that’s left is rage.

file: Rise of the Third Army Reading Order.html
title: Rise of the Third Army
desc: Feeling that the Green Lantern Corps are fundamentally flawed due to free will,  the Guardians of the Universe aim to replace the Green Lanterns with their new universal solution,  the Third Army,  as well as wiping out all other Lantern Corps.

file: War of the Green Lanterns Reading Order.html
title: War of the Green Lanterns
desc: Green Lanterns Hal Jordan,  Guy Gardner,  John Stewart,  Kyle Rayner,  Kilowog,  and Guardian of the Universe Ganthet face off against their mind controlled fellow Green Lanterns and try to stop the renegade Guardian Krona from taking over the universe.

file: Wrath of the First Lantern Reading Order.html
title: Wrath of the First Lantern
chars: Green Lantern Corps,  Red Lantern Corps
desc: The First Lantern is free and wants revenge for his years of imprisonment.  He begins entering the minds and memories of the various beings present on Oa with the intention of examining their lives,  to see how their life choices had changed them and altering events in order to see them suffer.
